focus: پیشرفته ۲ · جلسه هشتم · چه چیزی مجاز است

sentences.fa: قبل از بستن قرارداد مي خوايي با يه نفر قرارداد ببندي؟
sentences.en: Before you conclude the contract, would you like to consult with anyone?

sentences.fa: قبل از بستن قرارداد، مي خوايي بري خونه و روش فکر کني؟
sentences.en: Before you conclude the contract, would you like to go home and sleep on it?

sentences.fa: قبل از بستن قرارداد، مي خوايي يه نگاه بهش بندازي؟
sentences.en: Before you conclude the contract, would you like to take a look at it?

sentences.fa: ايرادي داره ازت بخوام يکم بيشتر در مورد قرارداد توضيح بدي؟
sentences.en: Do you mind if I ask you to explain a bit more about this contract?

sentences.fa: همه چي رو بهت توضيح مي دم، قبل از فسخ قرارداد مي خوايي قرارداد قبلي رو بررسي کني؟
sentences.en: I am explaining everything for you, before you terminate the contract, would you like to look into the previous contract?

sentences.fa: قبل از تمديد قرارداد، مي خوايي شرايطم رو بدوني؟
sentences.en: Before you renew/repeat the contract, would you like to know my conditions?

sentences.fa: بعد از مرگ پدرت چقدر ارث گرفتي؟
sentences.en: How much have you inherited after your father's death?

sentences.fa: به من يه ميليون دلار ارث گرفتم.
sentences.en: I have been inherited one million dollars.

sentences.fa: قبل از اينکه وصيت کني مي خوايي با وکيلت مشورت کني؟
sentences.en: Before you make a will would you like to consult with your lawyer?

sentences.fa: قبل از اينکه پدرت رو توي بيمارستان بستري کني، مي خواهي معاينه اش کني؟
sentences.en: Before you lay up your father in the hospital, would you like to examine him?

sentences.fa: با رييس يه قرار گذاشتم.
sentences.en: I have made an appointment with the chairman.

sentences.fa: قبل از مذاکره با کمپاني، مي خواي شرايط من رو بدوني؟
sentences.en: Before you negotiate with this company, would you like to know my conditions?

sentences.fa: متأسفانه چکت برگشت خورده، قبل از حواله پول به حسابم ميخواهي حسابت رو چک کني؟
sentences.en: Unfortunately, your check has been bounced; before you remit the money in my account would you like to check your account.

sentences.fa: اجازه داريم آپارتمان رو اجاره به غير بديم؟
sentences.en: Are we allowed to sublet the flat?

sentences.fa: اجازه داريم قرارداد رو قبل موعد مقرر ختم کنيم؟
sentences.en: Are we allowed to terminate the contract by the due time?

sentences.fa: اجازه داريم قرارداد رو خارج آژانس املاک تمديد کنيم؟
sentences.en: Are we allowed to repeat the lease out of a real estate agency?

sentences.fa: ديروز يادم رفت از صاحبخونه بپرسم.
sentences.en: I forgot to ask the question from my landlord yesterday.

sentences.fa: درست نمي دونم اجازه دارم اينجا رو به غير اجاره بدم يا نه؟
sentences.en: I wonder whether we are allowed to sublet here or not.

sentences.fa: با اين حال، بهتره با صاحبخونه ات چکش کني.
sentences.en: Then again, you had better check it with your landlord.

sentences.fa: اجاره به غير مجاز نيست.
sentences.en: Subletting isn't permitted.

sentences.fa: متأسفانه اجاره به غير مجاز نيست.
sentences.en: I am afraid subletting isn't allowed.

sentences.fa: متأسفانه فراموش کردم يسري چيزها بهت رو بگم، متأسفانه گرفتن مهموني توي اين ساختمان مجاز نيست.
sentences.en: I am afraid I have forgotten to tell you something, taking a party in not allowed in this building.

sentences.fa: متأسفانه، اون نکته در فرمتون نوشته شد، داشتن همراه مجاز نيست.
sentences.en: I am afraid that point has been written in your form, having an accompanier is not allowed.

sentences.fa: تا دم در همراهيت مي کنم.
sentences.en: I am showing you to the door.

sentences.fa: که اينطور، از شومينه مي شه استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: I see, is it alright to use the fireplace?

sentences.fa: مي شه درب رو قفل کني؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to lock the door?

sentences.fa: از اونجايي که آسانسور ديروز خراب بود، مي شه ازش استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: Since the elevator was out of service yesterday, is it alright to use the elevator?

sentences.fa: مي شه از پله برقي استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to use the escalator?

sentences.fa: مي شه از راه پله استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to use the staircase?

sentences.fa: مي شه اينجا پارک کرد يا متعلق به معلولين هست؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to park here or it belongs to disables?

sentences.fa: مي شه غذا رو سفارش داد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to order the food?

sentences.fa: مي شه از ATM استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to use the ATM?

sentences.fa: مي شه مقداري پول از ATM برداشت کرد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to withdraw any money at this ATM?

sentences.fa: مي شه اين کرم رو به هواپيما برد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to carry this cream on the plane?

sentences.fa: تحت هيچ شرايطي نبايد از شومينه استفاده کني.
sentences.en: You mustn't under any circumstances use the fireplace.

sentences.fa: داشت يادم مي رفت بذار يه چيزهايي بهت بگم، همکارم همش توي اداره گوش وا مي ايسته.
sentences.en: I almost forgot let me tell you something, my colleague is always overhearing in the office.

sentences.fa: شما تحت هيچ شرايطي با هيچ کسي نبايد در اين زمينه صحبت کني، خيلي محرمانه هست.
sentences.en: You mustn't under any circumstances speak to anyone in this respect, it's very confidential.

sentences.fa: شما محاصره اي، نمي توني تحت هيچ شرايطي فرار کني.
sentences.en: You are surrounded; you can't under any circumstances run away.

sentences.fa: شوهر من خيلي شکمو هست، نمي تونه تحت هيچ شرايطي خوردن را قطع کنه.
sentences.en: My husband is very greedy; he can't under any circumstances stop eating.

sentences.fa: قول مي دم آنها تحت بازرسي بدنيت مي کنن، نبايد تحت هيچ شرايطي اسحله رو ببري.
sentences.en: I promise they will search your body; you mustn't under any circumstances carry your gun.

sentences.fa: تازه سرپا شدي، نبايد تحت هيچ شرايطي بخيه هات رو تحت فشار قرار بدي.
sentences.en: You have just been up and about; you mustn't under any circumstances overuse your stiches.

sentences.fa: شما نبايد تحت هيچ شرايطي قرارداد رو تغيير بدي.
sentences.en: I mustn't under any circumstances change the contract.

sentences.fa: مسئول اين پرونده منم.
sentences.en: I am in charge of this file.

sentences.fa: همه کاره اين شرکت منم و شما تحت هيچ شرايطي نمي توني توي شغلم دخالت کني.
sentences.en: I run the show in this company and you can't under any circumstance interfere my job.

sentences.fa: همه کاره اينجا کيه؟
sentences.en: Who runs the show here?

sentences.fa: نمي توني تحت هيچ شرايطي توي زندگيم دخالت کني.
sentences.en: You can't under any circumstance poke your nose into my life.

sentences.fa: تحت هيچ شرايطي نمي توني مفاد قرارداد رو عوض کني.
sentences.en: You can't under any circumstance change the premises of the contract.

sentences.fa: مي شه از شومينه استفاده کرد؟
sentences.en: Is it alright to use the fireplace?

sentences.fa: شما تحت هيچ شرايطي نمي توني از شومينه استفاده کني، اون متعلق به طبقه دو هست.
sentences.en: You can't under any circumstance use the fireplace; it belongs to the second floor.

words.en: Interfere/ poke your nose into something

words.fa: مي خواي بري خونه و روش فکر کني؟
words.en: Would you like to go home and sleep on it?

words.fa: تا دم درب همراهيت مي کنم.
words.en: I am showing you to the door.

words.en: You can't under any circumstance poke your nose into my life.

conversation: A: Before you sign the lease, have you got any questions?
B: Yes, are we allowed to sublet the flat?
A: No, I am afraid. Subletting isn't permitted.
B: I see, well is it alight to use the fireplace?
A: You mustn't under any circumstances use the fireplace.
B: Well, do you allow people to have pets?
A: No that's out of the question. We don't allow anyone to have pets.
B: How about parking in front of the building?

A: I'm sorry. You are not supposed to park in front of the building. And before I forget, I should mention that you cannot alter the premises in anyway without permission. Have you got any other questions?
B: No, I think you have answered them all.
